title: Minipurge:Grey
description: Add-on to Minipurge. Adds custom recipes tailored to faster Minipurge progression.
body:
# ⚔️ Minipurge: Grey | Fast-Paced Progression Add-on

**Skip the grind and get straight to the action!** Minipurge: Grey is an official add-on for the [Minipurge](https://modrinth.com/datapack/minipurge) event framework designed by Smite_Blade to accelerate early-game gearing. 

By introducing a carefully balanced set of custom crafting recipes, this data pack ensures players spend less time hiding in caves and more time fighting. It is perfect for fast-paced events, shorter play sessions, or servers that want to keep the adrenaline pumping!

---

## ✨ What's Included?

**🛡️ Faster Armor Progression:** Craft essential gear using cheaper, custom recipes (like iron nuggets to armor). Experience the exact same satisfying gear progression without the tedious resource grind.

![Iron Armor Redone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/221c2e2a4a1a6b11b7ed65c1850bf62ca6f56f3e_0.webp)

![Diamond Armor Redone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae4c9c717590f0fb514c3ba7f58189437fe4f1b7.png)

![Upgrade Template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d38556f25d085cacb203c10803bdeeae487676b3.png)

**🧪 Accessible Potions:** No Nether Fortress? No problem! This pack adds custom recipes for brewing basics.

![Potion Help](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9613db324562f545a70afae8ba9d7c4dc2939b65.png)

**🍎 Golden Apples:** Everyone could use some extra golden apples...

![Easy Golden Apples](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e90ef247d36ba2e930fd3b1acf1443745ce5bb98.png)

**⚔️ Expanded Arsenal:** Access to miscellaneous custom weapon recipes to give you the upper hand in battle.

![Misc Weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0dd18b752065b0b67e6c5371498d38024cc9c55d_0.webp)

---

## ⚙️ How to Install
1. Ensure the core **[Minipurge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/minipurge)** data pack is installed in your world.
2. Drop the `Minipurge:Grey` `.zip` file into your world's `datapacks` folder alongside it.
3. Start your event! Minipurge will automatically detect and integrate the custom recipes.

---

## 🛠️ Create Your Own Add-ons!
Minipurge is built to be a modular framework. Want to make your own custom recipes, loot tables, or events?
